turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm great, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My daughter wants to bake with me on Sunday. She's seven.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's sweet. What sounds more fun for her, decorating sugar cookies, or making a simple banana bread she can mash and stir?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, she'd love both.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, then you get to pick. Which one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a moment, my coworker is here. Please be quiet until I tell you I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do we have any coffee left?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There's a little bit in the jar.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Omar, do we still have garlic or did you use the last of it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think there's half a bulb in the cupboard by the kettle.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Half a bulb won't be enough. Could you grab some on your way back from work?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, anything else while I'm there?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe a lemon. And check if they have fresh parsley.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Got it, garlic, lemon, parsley.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm ready, let's go after this.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Give me a minute to find my shoes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. You were choosing a Sunday bake with your daughter.
